item.title: Optical sizes in variable fonts
item.description: How the opsz axis changes stroke contrast and spacing between caption and display sizes.
item.dc:creator: Ada Lovelace
item.content:encoded:
How the opsz axis changes stroke contrast and spacing between caption and display sizes.

This note walks through three families and shows where automatic optical sizing helps and where it hurts.

It also covers fallbacks for browsers without the axis, and a few measurements of layout shift when the font loads late, so the trade-offs are visible with numbers rather than opinion alone.
